parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` are test-fixture stub factories living in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must default to no-action to avoid coupling production or shared code to test semantics. Here both records are test fixtures, reinforcing the restraint. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7142857 suggests structural overlap that could theoretically be collapsed into a generic stub factory, doing so would mean shipping a generic helper whose sole consumers are test stubs — the right boundary is to leave each stub method co-located with its domain type.
